title: Continuity of tuning in the host polynomial
exact_target: For hosts of degree greater than two with a superstable cycle of fixed period, does tuning by a fixed inserted polynomial depend continuously on the host?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 5300007 (AMR-052-0007). CC BY 4.0.
